app.name: Pulse
app.tagline: Sugar care for the whole family
menu.title: Menu
auth.name: Your name
auth.phoneHint: So your family can call you from the app
auth.intro: Log sugar, meals and medicines in a tap. Your family sees how today is going.
auth.error.taken: An account with this email already exists
auth.error.name: Enter your name
auth.accountType.doctorHint: Look after families who invite you
auth.clinicHint: Families see this next to your name
common.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
forbidden.title: You can't open this
forbidden.body: This part of the profile hasn't been shared with you. Ask the patient if you need it.
home.emptyBody: Your login isn't linked to a family yet. Ask a family member for an invite code to join their family.
home.leadPrompt: Setting up Pulse for your family?
role.owner.you: This is your own profile. You decide who sees what.
role.owner.about: This is your own health profile. You decide what each family member can see.
role.caregiver.about: You can log sugar, manage medicines and get alerts.
role.family.about: You can log meals and tick medicines as taken.
profile.title: Add a family member
profile.subtitle: You are the family lead. After adding them, send an invite so their own login is linked to your family.
profile.name: Their name
profile.nameHint: For example: Papa, or Ramesh Sharma
profile.error.name: Enter a name
profile.error.notLead: Only the family lead can add family members.
join.error.invalid: This invite code is not valid or has expired. Ask for a new one.
join.error.already: You are already in this family
join.error.ownerTaken: This profile already has a patient. Ask for a family invite instead.
family.moodOwnerOnly: Only the patient can share this
family.removeBody: {name} will lose access right away. You can invite them again later.
family.subtitleManage: Choose who is in the family and what each person sees.
family.notJoined: {name} hasn't joined yet. Invite them as the patient so they control who sees what.
invite.title: Invite someone
invite.ownerNote: They will own this profile and decide what everyone sees.
invite.codeReady: Share this code. It works once.
invite.whatsappText: {name} invited you to {patient}'s care circle on Pulse. Open {url} or enter code {code}. Valid for 48 hours.
meds.adherence: of doses taken in the last 7 days ({taken} of {total})
meds.stopBody: Only do this if the doctor has stopped it. Its history stays saved.
meds.emptyManage: No medicines yet. Add {name}'s medicines below.
meds.name: Medicine
meds.error.name: Enter the medicine name
meds.error.dose: Keep the dose short, like 500 mg
alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.empty: No alerts. Dangerous sugar readings show up here.
check.promptBody: Two quick questions. Only you see the answers.
check.addToDoctor: Yes, add to my doctor link
home.insightsLink: What seems to move the sugar
insights.title: Insights
insights.chartSubtitle: Shaded band: target range {low} to {high} mg/dL
insights.noFasting: No fasting readings in the last 30 days yet.
insights.needMore: Log {count} more after-dinner readings to see what affects your sugar.
insight.mealDinner: After dinners with {high}, sugar seems to run higher: it averaged {highAvg}. With {low}, {lowAvg}.
insight.meal: After meals with {high}, sugar seems to run higher: it averaged {highAvg}. With {low}, {lowAvg}.
insight.walkLower: The morning after a walk, fasting sugar seems lower: it averaged {walked}, against {rest} after days without a walk.
insight.walkHigher: The morning after a walk, fasting sugar seems higher: it averaged {walked}, against {rest} after days without a walk.
insight.meds: In weeks with most doses taken, fasting sugar averaged {good}. In weeks with more missed doses, {low}.
insight.trend.up: This week's fasting average is {now}, up from {last} last week.
insight.trend.down: This week's fasting average is {now}, down from {last} last week.
insight.trend.steady: This week's fasting average is {now}, about the same as last week ({last}).
share.title: Doctor link
share.subtitle: Before the clinic visit: add the latest HbA1c and send the doctor a one-page summary of {name}'s last 90 days.
share.hba1cHint: From the lab report, as a percent.
share.error.date: Enter a date that isn't in the future
share.linkHint: Read-only, no login, works for 7 days. You can cancel it any time.
share.ready: Link ready. Send it to the doctor.
share.whatsappText: {name}'s 90-day sugar summary from Pulse (read-only, valid 7 days): {url}
share.inactive: This link is no longer active
share.inactiveBody: It has expired or was cancelled. Ask the patient's family for a new one.
doctor.noPatterns: Not enough data for patterns yet.
doctor.noMood: No weekly check in this period.
doctor.footer: Patient-reported readings from a home glucometer, logged in the Pulse app. Plain averages, not a diagnosis.
demo.syntheticLong: Synthetic demo data, not a real patient
settings.title: Profile settings
settings.limitsHint: Change these only on the doctor's instruction. Readings below {urgentLow} or at {urgentHigh} and above are always urgent.
settings.deleteHint: This permanently removes {name}'s profile, readings, meals, medicines, checks and doctor links for everyone in the family. It cannot be undone.
push.denied: Blocked. Allow notifications for Pulse in Chrome settings.
push.dueBody: Your {time} dose. Tap Taken after you take it.
call.error.notFamily: You can only call people in this family.
call.notice.offline: They are not on Pulse right now. Try a phone call.
call.notice.notAllowed: Calls in Pulse are only between the family and their doctor.
call.notice.noMedia: Allow the microphone (and camera) to make calls
call.offlineSelf: Calls aren't connected right now. Refresh the page, or use a phone call.
photo.take: Take a photo of the meal
photo.fix: Foods ticked from the photo. Tap to fix.
photo.hint: Fit the whole plate in the frame
photo.noCamera: The camera didn't open. Choose a photo instead.
photo.privacy: Foods are found by AI (Google Gemini). Check them before saving. The photo is not saved.
photo.error.notFood: No food found in this photo. Try again or tap the foods below.
photo.error.failed: Couldn't read the photo. Try again or tap the foods below.
photo.error.tooBig: The photo is too large. Try again.
photo.error.off: Photo logging is not set up. Tap the foods below.
photo.error.busy: The food reader is busy right now. Try again in a minute, or tap the foods below.
role.doctor.about: You can read the sugar readings, meals and medicines shared with you, add lab results, and take calls from the family.
call.error.doctorOnly: Calls in Pulse are only with the doctor.
log.viewOnly: Doctors can read the logs but don't add them. See Home, Medicines and Insights.
profile.familySubtitle: You already have your own profile. Add someone you help care for.
invite.whatsappOwnerText: {name} set up your health profile on Pulse. Open {url} to make your own login and check your sugar, medicines and meals. Or enter code {code}. Valid for 48 hours.
login.title: Give {name} their own login
login.body: Send this link to {name}. They open it on their phone, set a password, and can check their own sugar, medicines and meals any time.
login.findAgain: You can find this link again on the Family page.
login.homeTitle: {name} doesn't have their own login yet
login.homeBody: Send them a link so they can check their own sugar and medicines.
invite.headNote: A family head sees all readings, meals and medicines. The weekly check stays private unless the patient shares it.
booking.title: Doctor calls
booking.subtitle: Book a call with the doctor for anyone in the family.
booking.subtitleDoctor: Calls the family booked with you. Accept or decline, then call at the time.
booking.noDoctor: No doctor has joined yet. Invite your doctor from the Family page; they accept the invite to see this profile.
booking.formHint: The doctor gets the request and confirms it.
booking.member: Who will talk to the doctor
booking.booked: Booked for {when}. Waiting for the doctor to confirm.
booking.callEarly: Confirmed. You can call {name} now or at the time.
booking.opensSoon: You can start the call from 10 minutes before the time.
booking.error.past: Choose a time at least 5 minutes from now
booking.error.tooFar: Choose a time within the next 60 days
approle.admin.about: Runs the family's health: members, medicines, sharing.
approle.caregiver.about: Helps with doses and daily logs.
gate.view_health: You can't see this profile's health details.
gate.log_readings: Only the family's admin or caregivers can add readings.
gate.mark_doses: You can't tick doses for this profile.
profile.noDemo: Allergies and conditions show up here once they're added.
safety.notDiagnosis: Ranges are general guides, not a diagnosis. Your doctor sets your targets.
viewAs.aria: Preview the app as another role
viewAs.label: View as
viewAs.previewNote: Preview only. Nothing you see here changes real permissions.
vitals.demoNote: BP and weight are sample data for the demo.
vitals.noDataBody: Readings show up here once someone logs them.
vitals.subtitle: {name}'s sugar, BP and weight over time
home.chartEmpty: No fasting readings in the last {days} days yet.
home.stat.noWeekReadings: No readings in the last 7 days
home.stat.walkedOf: Days with a walk, last 7 days
cal.title: Month at a glance
cal.r.nothing: Nothing was logged on this day.
cal.pick: Tap a day to see why it is marked.
cal.rules.title: How days are marked
cal.rules.alert: Very low or high: any reading that shows as Low or High. This comes first.
cal.rules.watch: Needs a look: a missed dose, or a reading above target.
cal.rules.good: Good day: something was logged and none of the above happened.
cal.rules.empty: Nothing logged: no readings or doses that day. A walk alone does not count.
doctorHome.emptyBody: Ask the family to invite you as their doctor from the Family page in Pulse. They will send you a 6-letter code; enter it below.
doctorHome.codeHint: Each family sends its own code. You only see what that family shares with you.
